{{Quote|The outpost is secure, General. We've shut down the alarm and turned on the 'All Clear' signal.|Sparky, to [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]|audio=OutpostIsSecure-Rookies.flac|<ref name="rookies">{{TCW|Rookies (episode)}}</ref>}}
"'''Sparky'''" was the nickname given to a [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|BX-series droid commando]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] by [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Hevy/Legends|Hevy]] who led a team of other [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|BX-series droid commandos]] in the [[Defense of Rishi Station/Legends|battle of the Rishi moon]]. Unlike his other commandos, Sparky carried a [[Vibrosword/Legends|vibrosword]] and bore a white symbol on his forehead.

==Biography==
{{Quote|No sign of them. They must have been pulverized. Resume defensive posts.|Sparky, on the status of Cody and Rex|audio=ResumeDefensivePosts-Rookies.flac|<ref name="rookies" />}}
[[File:RishiBXcommander.png|thumb|left|200px|The commando droid captain at the ready]]
After landing in [[Droch-class boarding ship/Legends|''Droch''-class boarding ships]] on [[Rishi moon]], the droid killed [[Droidbait/Legends|Droidbait]]. As he entered the [[Listening post/Legends|listening post]], he shot and killed [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[O'Niner/Legends|O'Niner]], and another clone, [[CT-327/Legends|CT-327]]. The remaining four clones, [[Fives/Legends|Fives]], [[Echo/Legends|Echo]], [[Hevy/Legends|Hevy]] and [[Cutup/Legends|Cutup]] escaped through the ventilation system, one of the commando droids reported of the missing clones but Sparky thought that they were inferior. Taking control of the base, he replaced the alarm with an "All Clear" signal. Afterward, he contacted [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], who told him to continue the transmission of the signal. When [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] arrived, the lead commando and his team ambushed and destroyed their means of transportation. When the unit of clones took back the station, he engaged Rex with his vibrosword. However, the clone captain gained the upper hand, snapping the droid's neck and ramming his head into the ground.
